To evaluate the readability of the provided text, we can apply two standard formulas: the Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level and the Gunning Fog Index.

**1. Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level Formula:**
$$0.39 \times (\frac{\text{Total Words}}{\text{Total Sentences}}) + 11.8 \times (\frac{\text{Total Syllables}}{\text{Total Words}}) - 15.59$$

*   Average Sentence Length: $38 / 2 = 19$ words
*   Average Syllables per Word: $62 / 38 \approx 1.63$
*   Calculation: $(0.39 \times 19) + (11.8 \times 1.63) - 15.59$
*   $7.41 + 19.23 - 15.59 = 11.05$

**Result:** The text is at an **11th-grade** reading level.

**2. Gunning Fog Index Formula:**
$$0.4 \times ((\frac{\text{Total Words}}{\text{Total Sentences}}) + 100 \times (\frac{\text{Complex Words}}{\text{Total Words}}))$$

*   Calculation: $0.4 \times (19 + 100 \times (10 / 38))$
*   $0.4 \times (19 + 26.32)$
*   $0.4 \times 45.32 = 18.13$

**Result:** The text is at an **18th-grade** reading level (college graduate level).
